gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-114.635103 32.682658)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 60 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

),
dem_subset AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Dump(r.rast)).val AS elevation,
    ST_Distance(h.geom, ST_Transform((ST_Dump(r.rast)).geom, 4326)::geography) AS distance_meters
  FROM public.dem_us r,
  hospital_geom h
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(h.geom, r.rast::geometry)::geography)
    AND (ST_Dump(r.rast)).val < 60
),
min_distance AS (
  SELECT MIN(distance_meters) AS min_distance
  FROM dem_subset
)
SELECT min_distance AS distance_to_lower_land_meters
FROM min_distance;
